versions.turbofigBinary: turbofig 0.1.0 (at turbofig, proxies to the running daemon)

goalB_startupTime.method: Node script spawns the server over stdio, sends JSON-RPC 'initialize' then 'notifications/initialized' then 'tools/list', and times from process spawn to a successful tools/list response using process.hrtime.bigint(). No estimate: real wall-clock per run.

turbofig-mcp.note: stdio MCP server forwards onto the already-running daemon's POST /job; no job (execute/screenshot) was ever sent, only initialize + tools/list

console-mcp.note: A dummy token was required and sufficient: the server started and listed its full tool set without a real Figma personal access token.
console-mcp.coldRunNote: First invocation in this session (npm package was already present in the local npm cache from an earlier `npm view`, so this is 'npx resolve + spawn' cold, not a from-scratch npm download). Excluded from the warm N=5 set below.

goalC_toolDefinitionSize.method: Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(result.tools), 'utf8') from the same tools/list response used for goal B. Exact bytes, no token or char/4 estimate.

console-mcp.note: figma-console-mcp exposes a different, smaller tool count in Cloud Mode (96) and Remote SSE (read-only subset) per its own docs; only the default NPX mode was measured here.

note: Per-session token cost inside a real agent session is not included here; it is measured separately with bench/agent.ts.
